items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That was Ornette playing with me. It was my date

ctx.x: At the end of your Blue Note – phase of recording for Blue Note, you did a couple of – well, before that, the album with Ornette. Talk about that experience, how it came about and what that meant to you.

That was Ornette playing with me. It was my date, and Alfred asked me what I felt like to use Ornette. I told him great, because I was thinking of Ornette playing the saxophone. But when it came time to do the date, he wouldn’t – didn’t want to play the saxophone. He only wanted to play the trumpet. So we went ahead and did the date anyway, with him playing the trumpet. But I was a little upset, the fact that he wasn’t going to play saxophone. That was it.
What did you think of his trumpet playing?
